The '''1996–97 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 66th since its establishment. It began on 31 August 1996, and concluded on 23 June 1997. Five clubs were relegated to the [[Segunda División]] at the end of the season, as the number of La Liga clubs was reduced to 20 starting from the [[1997–98 La Liga|following season]]. This was thus the last La Liga season played with 22 teams.

* It was the last season with 22 teams in [[La Liga]]. To reduce the number of teams in the league, the last four teams, [[CF Extremadura]], [[Sevilla FC]], [[Hércules CF]] and [[CD Logroñés]], were relegated and the fifth-to-last team, [[Rayo Vallecano]], played a relegation playoff and was also relegated.
